title: ATLAS: summer heat, irrigation and crop yields in France (code and pipeline)
description: Reproducible pipeline (Python, R, DuckDB) and LaTeX sources of a research monograph on the association between summer heat and the irrigated-rainfed grain maize yield gap in French departments (2000-2025), with pre-specified analyses and a placebo check of the empirical size of inference in panels with common weather shocks. Includes the stand-alone R module wcr. Raw data are not redistributed; download scripts and SHA-256 manifest are included. Licences: code under MIT; text of the monograph and documentation under CC BY 4.0; data sources keep their own licences (see NOTICE.md).
